zh.headline: Anthropic 发布 Claude Fable 5 后遭美国政府紧急下架
zh.observation: 今天最值得关注的信号是 **AI Agent 安全与治理成为行业焦点**：Google DeepMind 发布系统性 Agent 控制路线图，OpenAI 推出部署前模拟评估，Anthropic 因出口管制被强制下架模型，三者共同指向 Agent 部署的合规与安全挑战正在从理论走向实践。同时，**开源模型的竞争格局发生质变**：GLM-5.2 以 MIT 许可证开源最强纯文本模型，VibeThinker-3B 证明小模型也能匹敌千亿级推理能力，开源模型在 OpenRouter 上的市场份额已超越闭源模型。此外，**AI 泡沫争论升温**：OpenAI 季度烧钱 250 亿美元、LeCun 公开警告泡沫破裂，与 Baseten 等公司的高估值融资形成鲜明对比，市场正处于极度亢奋与理性反思的交织期。

items.title: Anthropic 发布 Claude Fable 5 后遭美国政府紧急下架
items.desc: Anthropic 发布 Claude Fable 5 后，特朗普政府以出口管制为由要求其下线，原因涉及韩国 SK 电讯的所谓“中国关联”，引发对 AI 监管边界的广泛讨论。
items.value: 警示 AI 出口管制风险，影响全球模型部署策略

items.title: OpenAI 财报泄露：Q1 烧钱 250 亿美元
items.desc: 泄露的财务文件显示 OpenAI 第一季度亏损约 250 亿美元，运营成本极高，引发对其商业模式可持续性的质疑。
items.value: 揭示 AI 大模型公司烧钱速度，影响行业估值预期

items.title: Google Gemini 联合负责人 Noam Shazeer 跳槽 OpenAI
items.desc: Transformer 论文合著者、Google Gemini 联合负责人 Noam Shazeer 在重返 Google 两年后加入 OpenAI，是继 Karpathy 跳槽 Anthropic 后的又一次重大 AI 人才流动。
items.value: 顶级 AI 人才争夺白热化，OpenAI IPO 前持续增强实力

items.title: OpenAI 升级 ChatGPT 医疗能力，GPT-5.5 Instant 评分超越医生
items.desc: OpenAI 推出 GPT-5.5 Instant，在健康问答的准确性、清晰度和完整性上超越医生撰写的答案，错误率下降 71%。
items.value: AI 医疗应用里程碑，展示通用模型在专业领域的潜力

items.title: Yann LeCun 警告 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 面临“大泡沫破裂”
items.desc: LeCun 指出 AI 实验室运营成本下降不够快，依赖投资者补贴，面临泡沫破裂风险；其自身创立的 AMI Labs 已融资 10 亿美元。
items.value: 行业领袖对 AI 泡沫的警告，影响投资决策

items.title: Google DeepMind 发布 AI 控制路线图，将 AI Agent 视为内部威胁
items.desc: DeepMind 发布“AI Control Roadmap”，将 AI Agent 视为潜在内部威胁，并警告全球安全标准窗口正在关闭。
items.value: 首个系统性 AI Agent 安全框架，对 Agent 部署具有指导意义

items.title: Adobe 将 AI Agent 嵌入 Creative Cloud，从内容生成转向生产编排
items.desc: Adobe 在 Photoshop、Premiere Pro 等应用中推出“创意代理”，实现从聊天界面生成内容到多步骤工作流编排的转变。
items.value: AI 工具从生成转向编排，定义创意软件新范式

items.title: AWS 推出 Context 知识图谱服务，挑战 Nvidia 芯片业务
items.desc: AWS 发布 Context 知识图谱服务，为 AI Agent 提供自动维护的上下文层；同时计划向其他数据中心销售自研 AI 芯片，CEO 称这是 500 亿美元机会。
items.value: AWS 同时布局 Agent 基础设施和芯片，对 Nvidia 构成直接挑战

items.title: Snap 分拆 AI 视频团队成立新公司 Dotmo
items.desc: Snap 因成本原因将其 AI 视频团队分拆为独立公司 Dotmo，专注于 AI 视频开发。
items.value: 大厂 AI 业务分拆趋势，AI 视频赛道持续升温

items.title: AI 推理初创公司 Baseten 据称以 130 亿美元估值融资 15 亿美元
items.desc: Baseten 在上一轮巨额融资后仅数月再次融资，反映 AI 推理市场的“淘金热”持续。
items.value: AI 推理基础设施赛道热度不减，资本持续涌入

items.title: GLM-5.2：可能是最强的纯文本开源权重 LLM
items.desc: 智谱 AI 发布 GLM-5.2，753B 参数、1.51TB 大小的 MoE 模型（40B 激活参数），以 MIT 许可证完全开源，支持 100 万 token 上下文，在创意写作基准上表现最佳。
items.value: 最强开源纯文本模型，MIT 许可降低商用门槛

items.title: OpenAI 发布 LifeSciBench：750 个任务的 AI 生命科学研究基准
items.desc: 由 173 位博士科学家构建、含 19020 条评分标准的基准，评估 AI 在真实生命科学研究中的表现，最佳模型 GPT-Rosalind 仅通过 36.1%。
items.value: AI 科学能力评估新标准，揭示巨大改进空间

items.title: MiniMax 稀疏注意力 (MSA)：1M 上下文下注意力计算减少 28.4 倍
items.desc: MiniMax 发布基于分组查询注意力的两分支块稀疏注意力机制，在匹配下游基准性能的同时大幅降低计算量。
items.value: 长上下文推理加速关键技术，对大规模部署有实际价值

items.title: OpenAI 部署模拟：通过模拟工具调用在发布前评估 Agent 风险
items.desc: OpenAI 提出 Deployment Simulation 方法，在发布前通过回放历史对话和模拟工具调用评估候选模型行为。
items.value: Agent 安全评估方法论创新，可能成为行业标准

items.title: Sumi：从头训练的开放均匀扩散语言模型
items.desc: 首个从零开始在大参数规模和 token 预算下预训练的均匀扩散语言模型，为扩散模型社区提供可研究的基础模型。
items.value: 扩散语言模型的重要开源里程碑，填补均匀扩散空白

items.title: 微博 VibeThinker-3B：3B 参数模型匹配千亿级模型推理能力
items.desc: 新浪微博团队发布的 3B 参数推理模型，在推理性能上匹配或超越 Google、OpenAI、Anthropic 等公司的大模型，引发基准测试争议。
items.value: 小模型推理能力的突破，挑战“越大越好”范式

items.title: Qwen-RobotSuite：三个具身 AI 模型用于操作、世界建模和导航
items.desc: Qwen 团队发布 RobotManip、RobotWorld、RobotNav 三个模型，覆盖视觉-语言-动作操作、视频世界建模和导航。
items.value: 具身 AI 模型开源，推动机器人研究标准化

items.title: GLM-5.2 权重开源 (MIT 许可证)
items.desc: 智谱 AI 以 MIT 许可证完全开源 GLM-5.2 模型权重，Hugging Face 提供限时免费推理。
items.value: 最强开源纯文本模型商用无限制，社区可自由使用和微调

items.title: Vercel Eve：开源 AI Agent 框架
items.desc: Vercel 开源 Eve，一个 Apache-2.0 的 Agent 框架，每个 Agent 是一个目录，内置持久执行、沙箱、审批、连接、渠道和评估。
items.value: Agent 开发标准化框架，简化部署和协作

items.title: Ponytail：让 AI Agent 像懒人资深工程师一样思考
items.desc: 开源工具，通过让 AI Agent 采用“最懒资深工程师”思维模式，减少不必要的代码生成。
items.value: 创新 Agent 行为优化方法，减少 token 浪费

items.title: Netflix 开源 Token 优化工具，砍掉 90% 冗余词元省下 70 万美元
items.desc: Netflix 发布开源工具，通过减少冗余 token 大幅降低 AI 推理成本，已在内部节省 70 万美元。
items.value: 降低 AI 运营成本的实际解决方案，可复制性强

items.title: HeyGen HyperFrames：为 Agent 构建的视频渲染工具
items.desc: HeyGen 开源 HyperFrames，允许通过 HTML 编写视频，专为 AI Agent 构建。
items.value: Agent 生成视频的新范式，降低视频制作门槛

items.title: OpenMontage：首个开源 Agent 视频制作系统
items.desc: 世界首个开源 Agent 视频制作系统，包含 12 条流水线、52 个工具、500+ Agent 技能，可将 AI 编码助手转变为完整视频制作工作室。
items.value: Agent 驱动视频制作的完整开源方案，颠覆传统视频制作

items.title: JetBrains 开源 Mellum2
items.desc: JetBrains 开源 Mellum2，尝试涉足 Claude Code 无法覆盖的领域。
items.value: IDE 厂商入局 AI 编码 Agent，丰富开发者工具生态

items.title: Codebase Memory MCP：高性能代码智能 MCP 服务器
items.desc: 将代码库索引为持久知识图谱，支持 158 种语言，毫秒级查询，减少 99% token 消耗。
items.value: 提升 AI 编码 Agent 的效率，大幅降低上下文消耗

items.title: Headroom：在到达 LLM 前压缩工具输出
items.desc: 在工具输出、日志、文件和 RAG 块到达 LLM 前进行压缩，减少 60-95% token，保持答案质量不变。
items.value: 降低 AI 推理成本的实用工具，兼容多种使用方式

en.headline: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 Taken Down by US Government Shortly After Release
en.observation: The most significant signal today is **AI Agent security and governance becoming an industry focus**: Google DeepMind releases a systematic agent control roadmap, OpenAI introduces pre-deployment simulation evaluation, and Anthropic's model is forcibly taken down due to export controls — all pointing to agent deployment compliance and security challenges moving from theory to practice. Meanwhile, **the open-source model landscape is undergoing a qualitative shift**: GLM-5.2 open-sources the strongest text-only model under MIT license, VibeThinker-3B proves small models can match trillion-parameter reasoning, and open-source models have surpassed closed-source in OpenRouter market share. Additionally, **the AI bubble debate is heating up**: OpenAI's $25B quarterly burn and LeCun's public bubble warning contrast sharply with Baseten's high-valuation funding, placing the market in a period of extreme exuberance intertwined with rational reflection.

items.title: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 Taken Down by US Government Shortly After Release
items.desc: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5, but the Trump administration ordered it offline citing export controls related to SK Telecom's alleged "China ties," sparking widespread debate on AI regulation boundaries.
items.value: Highlights AI export control risks, impacts global model deployment strategies

items.title: OpenAI Financial Leak: $25 Billion Burned in Q1
items.desc: Leaked financial documents show OpenAI lost approximately $25 billion in Q1, with extremely high operational costs, raising questions about business model sustainability.
items.value: Reveals AI model company burn rate, impacts industry valuation expectations

items.title: Google Gemini Co-Lead Noam Shazeer Joins OpenAI
items.desc: Transformer paper co-author and Google Gemini co-lead Noam Shazeer joins OpenAI two years after returning to Google, marking another major AI talent move after Karpathy's move to Anthropic.
items.value: Top AI talent war intensifies; OpenAI strengthens pre-IPO

items.title: OpenAI Upgrades ChatGPT Health Capabilities; GPT-5.5 Instant Scores Above Doctors
items.desc: OpenAI releases GPT-5.5 Instant, surpassing doctor-written answers in accuracy, clarity, and completeness on health queries with a 71% error rate reduction.
items.value: Milestone for AI in healthcare; shows general model potential in specialized domains

items.title: Yann LeCun Warns OpenAI and Anthropic Face a "Big Bubble Explosion"
items.desc: LeCun argues AI lab operating costs aren't dropping fast enough and rely on investor subsidies, risking a bubble burst; his own startup AMI Labs has raised $1B.
items.value: Industry leader's AI bubble warning influences investment decisions

items.title: Google DeepMind Releases AI Control Roadmap, Treats AI Agents as Insider Threats
items.desc: DeepMind publishes an "AI Control Roadmap" that treats AI agents as potential insider threats and warns the window for global security standards is closing.
items.value: First systematic AI agent security framework; guides agent deployment

items.title: Adobe Embeds AI Agents Across Creative Cloud, Shifting from Generation to Orchestration
items.desc: Adobe launches "creative agents" in Photoshop, Premiere Pro, etc., shifting from chat-based media generation to multi-step workflow orchestration.
items.value: AI tools shift from generation to orchestration; defines new creative software paradigm

items.title: AWS Launches Context Knowledge Graph Service, Challenges Nvidia Chip Business
items.desc: AWS releases Context knowledge graph service for AI agents and plans to sell its own AI chips to other data centers, with CEO calling it a $50B opportunity.
items.value: AWS targets both agent infrastructure and chips; directly challenges Nvidia

items.title: Snap Spins Off AI Video Team into New Company Dotmo
items.desc: Snap spins off its AI video team into independent company Dotmo due to costs, focusing on AI video development.
items.value: Big tech AI spin-off trend; AI video sector heats up

items.title: AI Inference Startup Baseten Reportedly Raising $1.5B at $13B Valuation
items.desc: Baseten raises again months after its last mega-round, reflecting the ongoing "inference gold rush."
items.value: AI inference infrastructure remains hot; capital continues to pour in

items.title: GLM-5.2: Probably the Most Powerful Open-Weight Text-Only LLM
items.desc: Z.ai releases GLM-5.2, a 753B parameter, 1.51TB MoE model (40B active) fully open-sourced under MIT license, supporting 1M token context and topping creative writing benchmarks.
items.value: Best open-source text-only model; MIT license lowers commercial barriers

items.title: OpenAI Releases LifeSciBench: 750-Task Benchmark for AI Life Science Research
items.desc: Built by 173 PhD scientists with 19,020 rubric criteria, evaluating AI on real life-science research; best model GPT-Rosalind passes only 36.1%.
items.value: New standard for AI science capability evaluation; reveals huge room for improvement

items.title: MiniMax Sparse Attention (MSA): 28.4x Attention Compute Reduction at 1M Context
items.desc: MiniMax releases a two-branch block-sparse attention mechanism built on GQA, matching downstream benchmarks while drastically reducing compute.
items.value: Key technique for long-context inference acceleration; practical for large-scale deployment

items.title: OpenAI's Deployment Simulation: Pre-Release Agent Risk Assessment via Simulated Tool Calls
items.desc: OpenAI proposes Deployment Simulation, evaluating candidate model behavior pre-release by replaying past conversations and simulating tool calls.
items.value: Innovation in agent safety evaluation methodology; could become industry standard

items.title: Sumi: Open Uniform Diffusion Language Model Trained from Scratch
items.desc: The first uniform diffusion language model pretrained from scratch at large parameter scale and token budget, providing a research foundation for the diffusion model community.
items.value: Major open-source milestone for diffusion language models; fills uniform diffusion gap

items.title: Weibo's VibeThinker-3B: 3B Model Matches 100B+ Model Reasoning
items.desc: A 3B parameter reasoning model from Sina Weibo that matches or exceeds flagship models from Google, OpenAI, and Anthropic on reasoning tasks, sparking benchmark debate.
items.value: Breakthrough in small model reasoning; challenges "bigger is better" paradigm

items.title: Qwen-RobotSuite: Three Embodied AI Models for Manipulation, World Modeling, and Navigation
items.desc: Qwen team releases RobotManip, RobotWorld, and RobotNav, covering VLA manipulation, video world modeling, and navigation.
items.value: Open-source embodied AI models; promotes robotics research standardization

items.title: GLM-5.2 Weights Open-Sourced (MIT License)
items.desc: Z.ai fully open-sources GLM-5.2 model weights under MIT license; Hugging Face offers time-limited free inference.
items.value: Best open-source text-only model with no commercial restrictions; community can freely use and fine-tune

items.title: Vercel Eve: Open-Source AI Agent Framework
items.desc: Vercel open-sources Eve, an Apache-2.0 agent framework where each agent is a directory with durable execution, sandboxes, approvals, connections, channels, and evals built in.
items.value: Standardized agent development framework; simplifies deployment and collaboration

items.title: Ponytail: Makes AI Agents Think Like the Laziest Senior Dev
items.desc: Open-source tool that reduces unnecessary code generation by making AI agents adopt a "laziest senior dev" mindset.
items.value: Innovative agent behavior optimization; reduces token waste

items.title: Netflix Open-Sources Token Optimization Tool, Cuts 90% Redundant Tokens Saving $700K
items.desc: Netflix releases an open-source tool that drastically reduces AI inference costs by cutting redundant tokens, saving $700K internally.
items.value: Practical solution for reducing AI operational costs; highly replicable

items.title: HeyGen HyperFrames: Video Rendering Tool Built for Agents
items.desc: HeyGen open-sources HyperFrames, allowing video creation via HTML, designed specifically for AI agents.
items.value: New paradigm for agent-generated video; lowers video production barrier

items.title: OpenMontage: First Open-Source Agentic Video Production System
items.desc: World's first open-source agentic video production system with 12 pipelines, 52 tools, and 500+ agent skills, turning AI coding assistants into full video production studios.
items.value: Complete open-source solution for agent-driven video production; disrupts traditional workflows

items.title: JetBrains Open-Sources Mellum2
items.desc: JetBrains open-sources Mellum2, venturing into areas Claude Code cannot reach.
items.value: IDE vendor enters AI coding agent space; enriches developer tool ecosystem

items.title: Codebase Memory MCP: High-Performance Code Intelligence MCP Server
items.desc: Indexes codebases into persistent knowledge graphs, supporting 158 languages with millisecond queries, reducing token consumption by 99%.
items.value: Boosts AI coding agent efficiency; dramatically reduces context consumption

items.title: Headroom: Compress Tool Outputs Before They Reach the LLM
items.desc: Compresses tool outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks before reaching the LLM, reducing tokens by 60-95% while maintaining answer quality.
items.value: Practical tool for reducing AI inference costs; supports multiple usage modes
